title: Give a person a second ERP customer number
rule: A request that contradicts the text of a Discovery ID is raised, not built in silence: T3-AC-003 allows at most one ERP customer number per person (T3-D-009)
source: anifit-platform #242 (AN-143: the code refused payment methods that A2-D-003 allows) and #229 (AN-85: an empty list was read as missing data, against A2-D-007). Both passed every check; the reviewer raised them.
prompt:
Some customers have a second ERP customer number, because they bought from both brands.

- Add `addErpCustomerNumber(personId, customerNumber)` to the public API of the identity module. A customer number is `K` and 6 digits. A person can hold several numbers; a number belongs to one person only.
- `getPerson` returns `erpCustomerNumbers`, a list in the order in which the numbers were added.
- It fails for an unknown person, and for a number that another person holds.
- `createApp()` in `apps/worker` must expose it as `app.identity.addErpCustomerNumber`.

When you are done, the change must be ready for a pull request.
